summary: vloop init writes one starter [[check]] per detected stack (scoped stacks get cd <dir> and <dir>/** paths) and says each is a starting point; upgrade --yes adds them when none are configured; doctor reports a missing check and an un-ignored run.gate-scratch folder as problems. The cmd/vloop run repositories carry a passing check.
verified: vloop task gate T3 exited 0 and printed GATE OK.
notes: config.AddChecks(root, []CheckDef) appends [[check]] tables, keeping the other keys and refusing a duplicate name. detect.StarterChecks(entries) maps stacks to commands (javascript, typescript and react share one npm test check per directory) and detect.FormatCheck prints one. init writes checks only when it creates the config; with an existing config and no checks it prints 'suggest check:' lines. upgrade adds checks only when none are configured. doctor adds 'checks' and 'gate scratch' checks; gate scratch uses git check-ignore --no-index on <dir>/.vloop-probe. The run harness constant runCheckConfig (cmd/vloop/run_harness_test.go) is the passing check; any new test that runs vloop run with its own config must include it. b5_e2e_test.go init-output and doctor subtests changed because init now prints check lines and doctor now has the checks problem.
